players.product: PCB drills, incl. ULF-coated drills used to drill semiconductor package substrates, and long-flute drills

quarterly_data.quarter: Union Tool TDnet: Construction of a New Factory Building and Acquisition of (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The board resolved on October 16, 2026 to build Mitsuke No. 4 Factory, to increase production capacity for cutting tools (the company's core products) and establish the production and development infrastructure for future business expansion: a two-story building of approximately 6,600 m2 total floor area on the same site as the existing Mitsuke Factories Nos. 1-3 (Shinko-cho, Mitsuke-shi, Niigata Prefecture), scheduled for completion in February 2028. The company is also preparing to apply for approval of a Regional Economy Advancement Project Plan with a view to acquiring approximately 150,000 m2 of land in Sekihara-machi, Nagaoka-shi, Niigata Prefecture, where it plans to build a new factory as a new production base, scheduled for completion in 2030; building size and investment amount are to be determined after the plan approval. The company expects the impact on current-year results to be minor.
quarterly_data.figure: Mitsuke No. 4 Factory approx. 6,600 m2, completion February 2028; Nagaoka Sekihara-machi land approx. 150,000 m2, new factory completion 2030 (investment to be determined)
